dialect: Standard Serbian, ekavian (Belgrade norm), written in Latin script (latinica)

profile.pronunciation_convention: IPA, broad, pitch accent optional; spoken = stress hint
profile.grammar_notes: Copula biti with clitic present (sam, si, je, smo, ste, su) and full forms (jesam...); negated nisam/nije. Existence: ima / nema (+ genitive). Possession: imati, negated nemati. Negation: ne before verb, fused in nisam, nemam, neću. Questions: da li + clause, or li after verb, or intonation. Future: clitic ću/ćeš/će + infinitive, or verb stem + ću (radiću). Modals: moći, morati, hteti (clitic ću), trebati (impersonal treba da). Da + present replaces infinitive in many uses (hoću da idem). Seven cases; aspect pairs (perfective/imperfective) instead of many tenses. Politeness: Vi (capitalized in writing) vs ti. Clitic second-position ordering. Closed sets: personal pronouns (ja, ti, on, ona, ono, mi, vi, oni, one, ona), biti present clitics, days of week, question words.
